sceneries._n: OGRS Allotment — 4 plots in a 2x2 grid with 1-tile walking lanes between them. East of Lumbridge castle.
Compost heap — south-east corner, well clear of plot tiles. Compost model is 2x2 so it occupies (153..154, 653..654).
Garden fence — north perimeter only; keeps the hedged look without boxing the player out.
